headlines.title: 양극화 완화 TF 가동 …“ 재정·세제·금융·규제개선 등에 집중 ”
headlines.summary: 이형일 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 이끄는 양극화 대응 태스크포스(TF)가 본격적인 활동을 시작했습니다. 권대영 재정경제부 1차관과 현수엽 보건복지부 1차관은 오늘(12일) 오전 정부서울청사에서 관계 부처 및 청와대 당국자가 참석한 가운데 ‘양극화 대응 TF’ 총괄반 첫 회의를 열었습니다.

headlines.title: 정부, 양극화 대응 TF 가동 … 5대 분야 격차 완화책 연내 마련
headlines.summary: 노동·산업·지역·세대·사회분야…재정·세제·금융 등 묶어 지원 재정경제부. ⓒ 뉴스1 김기남 기자 (세종=뉴스1) 임용우 기자 = 정부가 노동시장과 산업·기업, 지역, 세대, 사회 등 5대 분야의 격차를 줄이기 위한 핵심과제를 발굴하기 위한 TF를 본격 가동한다.

headlines.title: " 모두가 성장하고 있나, 정부가 답할 때 " … 정부, '양극화 대응 TF' 본격 ...

headlines.title: ‘ 양극화 대응 ’ 범부처 TF 가동 … 조선업 원·하청 상생협약 추진

headlines.title: 충청권 메가프로젝트 착공기념 시삽하는 이 대통령
headlines.summary: (아산=연합뉴스) 신준희 기자 = 이재명 대통령이 12일 충남 아산 삼성전자 온양캠퍼스 건설현장에서 열린 충청권 메가프로젝트 착공식에서 이재용 삼성전자 회장 등과 함께 기념 시삽을 하고 있다.

headlines.title: 美 의회, ' 반도체 수출 통제 3법' 탄력...韓 업체에도 불똥 튀나
headlines.summary: [파이낸셜뉴스] 젠슨 황(왼쪽) 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 대만 타이베이에서 지난해 5월 22일(현지시간) 주최한 만찬에 앨리스 황이 참석해 미소 짓고 있다. AP 뉴시스 미국 의회의 대중국 반도체 수출 규제 강화 3법에 다시 탄력이 붙고 있다고 월스트리트저널(WSJ)이 11일(현지시간) 보도했다.

headlines.title: 반도체 호황 누른 유가 … KDI " 소비에 부정적 영향 먼저 반영 "
headlines.summary: 올해 유가 탓 소비 증가율 0.4%p↓…내년 반도체로 소비 증가율 0.6%p↑ "최고가격제, 3∼10월 소비자물가 상승률 평균 약 0.6%p 낮춰" "추가 수요 진작정책 필요성 크지 않아…비반도체 임금 여건 개선해야" 석유 최고가격제 12차 최고가격 발표 앞둔 주유소 (서울=연합뉴스) 박동주 기자 = 12일 서울 서초구 만남의광장 주유소에 유가가 표시돼있다

headlines.title: 반도체 호황 온기는 '아직' … 유가 충격에 민간소비 회복 '발목'
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 KDI, '최근 반도체 호황과 유가 상승이 민간소비에 미치는 영향' 보고서 KDI "반도체 효과는 4분기 뒤 나타나…올해 유가 충격에 소비 증가율 0.4%p 하락" 내년 반도체 효과 0.6%p 상승 전망…임금 정체·금리 부담은 변수 한국개발연구원(KDI) 경제전망실 김지연(가운데) 전망총괄 및 마창석(왼쪽)·이승희 연구위원.

headlines.title: 9월만 법인세 36조 걷혀 … 나라살림 적자 1년새 70조 축소
headlines.summary: 1~9월 32조 적자, 1년새 70.5조↓ 기업 호실적에 누적 법인세 52조↑ 중앙정부 채무 1369조, 101조 증가 기업 실적 개선에 따른 법인세 급증으로 올해 1~9월 나라살림 적자가 1년 새 70조원 넘게 줄었다. 9월 한 달에만 법인세가 36조원 넘게 걷히면서 월간 재정수지가 적자에서 흑자로 돌아섰다.

headlines.title: 국제금융기구 채용설명회 … 13개 기관 한국 찾아 면접 · 컨설팅

headlines.title: 내년 전국 오피스텔 기준시가 4년째 하락 … 서울은 2%대 상승

headlines.title: 서울 집합건물 증여받은 20대 1년새 2.2배↑
headlines.summary: 집값상승·稅부담에 조기증여 확산 1~10월 수증인 전년비 62% 증가 20대 828명→1781명 증가율 1위 청년 세대 간 자산 격차 심화 우려 높아진 집값과 세금 부담에 부동산 증여가 활발해지면서 서울의 집합건물을 물려받은 사람의 수가 1년 새 60% 넘게 급증한 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: “ 150조 미래기금, 첫해 사업비서 신규사업 48% 그쳐 ”
headlines.summary: 나라살림연구소, 2027년 예산안 분석 사업비 45.4조 중 계속사업에 23.6조 “기존사업 재편에 절반, 기금 효과 의문” 정부가 내년 신설하는 미래대응기금의 첫해 사업비 45조4000억원 가운데 절반 이상을 기존 사업에 배정하면서 기금의 신규 정책 효과를 둘러싼 의문이 제기되고 있다.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Congress Accelerates Semiconductor Export Controls, Potential Impact on Korean Companies
key_headlines.summary: The U.S. Congress is gaining momentum on three bills to strengthen semiconductor export restrictions targeting China, which could have spillover effects on Korean semiconductor manufacturers.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches Task Force to Address Income Inequality Across Five Sectors
key_headlines.summary: The government established a comprehensive task force led by Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hyung-il to address polarization in labor, industry, regional, generational, and social sectors through fiscal, tax, financial, and regulatory reforms.

key_headlines.title: Third Quarter GDP Growth Triples Expectations at 1.0%, Driven by Strong Exports
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's Q3 GDP growth reached 1.0% quarter-on-quarter, exceeding initial forecasts of 0.3%, with export volume growth hitting a record 43.9% year-on-year increase.

key_headlines.title: Oil Price Decline Dampens Consumer Spending Despite Semiconductor Boom Recovery
key_headlines.summary: The Korea Development Institute reports that rising oil prices reduced consumer spending by 0.4 percentage points this year, though semiconductor sector recovery is expected to boost consumption by 0.6 percentage points next year.

key_headlines.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal, Company Faces Leadership Transition Challenge
key_headlines.summary: Founder Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO following a scandal, with CFO Colette Kress appointed as interim CEO, raising uncertainty about major AI investments and financing initiatives he previously oversaw.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean economy is showing mixed signals with strong export performance but consumer spending challenges. Q3 GDP growth of 1.0% significantly exceeded expectations, driven by record export volume growth of 43.9% year-on-year. However, rising oil prices have dampened consumer spending growth. The government has launched a comprehensive task force to address income inequality across five key sectors, planning to implement coordinated fiscal, tax, financial, and regulatory reforms targeting 2027 economic growth.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Import prices declined 1.8% in October as won strengthened and international oil prices fell after months of increases. The government upgraded its economic assessment from 'recovery trend' to 'solid growth,' citing strong export and investment performance. Q3 cumulative growth rate reached 3.6% for the first three quarters of the year. Meanwhile, the U.S. fiscal deficit hit 539 trillion won in October, representing a 42% year-on-year increase, with annual deficit reaching approximately 6% of GDP, exceeding Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's 3% target.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market showed resilience despite Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, with KOSPI surging over 2% and KOSDAQ climbing 4% as investors pursued low-cost purchases of semiconductor stocks. Semiconductor and robot-related sectors led gains, with semiconductor industries rising 6.78% and robotics sectors jumping 10.01%. The Fed signaled potential December rate hikes, prompting market focus to shift from whether to raise rates to how much to increase by, while the won-dollar exchange rate attempted to reenter the 1,340 won level.
sections.Industry & Technology: CoWin Robotics saw robot sales surge threefold in Q3 with operating profit increasing 46%, expanding into advanced manufacturing sectors including MLCC electronic components beyond traditional battery and automotive industries. The government confirmed an 800.2 billion won AI semiconductor roadmap to develop eight domestically-produced AI chips by 2030, with Samsung prioritizing 2-nano process support for autonomous vehicles and home appliance chips. Korea formally lodged complaints at the WTO against EU battery and steel tariffs, while the government is establishing indigenous AI chip production to reduce dependency on foreign technology amid U.S. export controls.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices show divergent trends with declining prices spreading from Gangnam to the Han River belt areas, with Gangdong and Songdong districts posting price declines for the first time in 30 weeks. However, jeonse (long-term deposit rental) prices continue rising due to tight supply, preventing price declines from spreading to Seoul's outer regions. Sejong city apartment prices are expected to continue rising driven by anticipation of government relocation completion, while the Ministry of Land Transportation indicated year-end base rate increases could accelerate housing price declines. The former CBS broadcast building in Mokdong will be redeveloped into senior housing and commercial facilities as part of Seoul's urban renewal strategy.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced it will reduce 2027 FOMC meetings from eight to seven rate-decision meetings, with October's meeting focused solely on monetary policy strategy discussions without voting on rates. President Trump demanded Mexico strengthen border enforcement against illegal immigration, threatening to double tariffs if compliance fails. Fed officials signaled potential December rate hikes with discussions shifting from whether to hike to how much to increase rates, and the Fed moved December's meeting to November as part of its 2027 schedule adjustments.
sections.AI & Economy: SinonAI simultaneously received approvals for three key divisions (industrial complex, defense, and factory) in the government-backed M.AX Alliance platform for AI transformation. Nvidia faces its first major test post-Jensen Huang resignation with Q3 earnings announcement scheduled for November 17 and a company-wide meeting on November 18 to address leadership transition concerns and future AI investment strategies. Anthropic is proceeding with Nasdaq listing despite valuation concerns, with domestic venture capital maintaining strong AI investment momentum at over 1 trillion won in October investments, with AI and robotics accounting for 53% of total startup investments.
sections.Others: The government is promoting non-capital region industrial investments to address unemployment, with 27.4% of major corporations reviewing non-Seoul area investments, supported by 81.6 billion won in subsidies and eased criteria. Korean cosmetics companies continue dominating Japan's import market with 30.8% market share, maintaining the top position for four consecutive years, while K-beauty products expand their presence across major Japanese commercial districts from Tokyo to Osaka. Concerns mount over Nvidia's major AI investment and financing support business following Jensen Huang's departure, as these initiatives directly funded by the founder's vision face uncertainty under interim leadership.
